name: Impostor syndrome
description: A trainer for fighting self-doubt before an important presentation.

start.text: Presentation to the client tomorrow. I am sure that everything looks like a kindergarten. I will be fired.

options.text: It's scary. What exactly scares the most?
Kindergarten? You made the report yourself, it is professional. What is the problem?
Again for your own? Your insecurity is annoying.
Well, if you think so, it probably is...

emp_1.text: Everything is scary. Each digit. I can't seem to answer even a simple question.

options.text: Let's go through the most difficult together?
Prepare a cheat sheet for the questions you are afraid of.
I can't help now. Rest, you did what you could.
You don't know your project - you deserve to be fired.

neu_1.text: They ask about scaling, and there are crutches. They will eat in 5 minutes.

options.text: Architecture is always a compromise. Prepare an argument why this is so.
Be honest that this is a temporary solution with a refactoring plan.
Unable to comment right now. bye
Did you write the crutches yourself and are you afraid? Ridiculously.

bad_1.text: I trusted you, and you mock me! I'll be bitten and that's it.

options.text: Sorry, that's not what I meant. What specifically scares?
The end after one presentation? You exaggerate.
I overdid it. Let's talk tomorrow.
Don't trust anyone. Do it yourself.

sad_1.text: do you see Even you think that I am not a real specialist. I will refuse to speak.

options.text: Stop, I said something stupid. You know the project best.
If you refuse, you will definitely be replaced.
That's not what I meant. Both were tired. bye
Refuse. Someone else will get the bonus.

emp_2.text: And if they start pressuring and ridiculing? I'll just shout.

options.text: You have the right to say: 'Thank you, we will look into it.'
Customers are not enemies. They want the project to take off.
Maybe it's really better not to go on stage.
Maybe they really will be evil...

neu_2.text: I still panic. I feel that I am being seen through.

options.text: A classic impostor. You know more than you think.
No one sees through. Everyone is busy with their own.
You consider yourself worthless - what should I do about it?
Maybe they will really notice something wrong...

bad_2.text: I just want to hear: 'You'll make it.' Is it that difficult?

options.text: You will manage. I can see it in your work.
Depends on the preparation. Let's go through the slides.
Normal specialists do not ask for compliments at night.
Tried to help, but you don't listen.

emp_3.text: Maybe I'm exaggerating. But the voice inside says: 'You are a liar.'

options.text: This is anxiety, not truth. You worked for months.
Write down three things you did well. Facts versus panic.
You are stronger than this voice. It's time for me, I believe in you.
Maybe this voice knows something?

neu_3.text: OK, I'll try. But what if I forget the numbers and hang up?

options.text: Keep notes. No speaker speaks without them.
If you forget, say "I'll clarify after the meeting." This is normal.
You won't forget. It's time for me, tomorrow everything will be ok.
If you forget the numbers of your project, then I won't be able to help you.

bad_3.text: All. I will write that I got sick. I will not go to the presentation.

options.text: Wait. If you retreat, the fear will only grow.
Running away is the end. The ice will understand that you are angry.
Your decision. Think with a fresh head.
Refuse. Everyone will know who you are.

emp_4.text: You are right. I will come out tomorrow and tell you what I know.

options.text: That's right. Just be yourself.
Right. get some sleep
I finally understood.
It would have been like this, instead of panic.

neu_4.text: OK, I'll go through the slides and go to bed earlier.

options.text: You are better prepared than you think. Good night!
Sleep is the best plan. See you tomorrow.
Nothing will work without confidence.
The main thing is not to sit until morning.

bad_4.text: You don't understand. You never felt like a fraud at work.

options.text: I see how difficult it is for you. Let's go through the slides shall we?
It's already late. Postpone the decision until the morning.
Everyone doubts. You are not unique.
Once I don't understand, there's nothing to talk about.

emp_5.text: Thank you. It became calmer. I will look at the slides and go to sleep.

options.text: You will manage! I keep my fists. Good night!
See you tomorrow. Good night.
Come on, go. Tomorrow is an important day.
Just don't panic again at night.

neu_5.text: Tomorrow will be as it will be. I'm going to sleep.

options.text: Everything will be fine. I believe in you!
See you tomorrow. Good night.
rest Good luck tomorrow.
Well, that's good. Less drama.

bad_5.text: I will throw everything. I will submit an application in the morning. Not suitable for this job.

options.text: Don't make decisions at night. get some sleep
Not everyone can withstand pressure.
Let's talk about it tomorrow. Emotions now.
give it One thread less.

good_end.text: You helped a colleague to believe in himself.

neutral_end.text: The colleague calmed down, but doubts remained.

bad_end.text: Fear won. A colleague is thinking about dismissal.

rude_exit.text: You confirmed a colleague's worst fears.
